question: Dadabhai Naoroji was a _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Businessman**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 
 **Dadabhai Naoroji **was a businessman and a **great publicist who settled in London.**
 
 
• 
 He was the **first Asian to become a British Member of Parliament** when he was elected to the** House of Commons in 1892.**
 
 
• 
 He formed the** London India Society in 1865 **to put forth views on **Indian political, social and literary subjects.**
 
 
• 
 He also** founded the East India Association in 1867 **with the purpose of putting across Indian viewpoints across to the British public.
 
 
• 
 **He was the President of the Congress Party in 1886, 1893 and 1906.**
 
 
• 
 
**Naoroji’s book Poverty and Un-British Rule in India **offered scathing criticism of the economic impact of British rule.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The first attempt to calculate the** national income of India was made by Dadabhai Naoroji.**
 
• He estimated a National Income of** Rs. 340 crores and per capita income of Rs.20 in the year 1867-68.**
 
• ​He was also known as the** Indian Gladstone and Grand Old Man of India.**
 
• He was the first Indian to be elected to the House of Commons on a Liberal Party ticket.
